related.description: 📝A simple and elegant markdown editor, available for Linux, macOS and Windows.
A very fast and versatile markdown toolchain. Output to AST, React, React Native, SolidJS, Vue, HTML, and more!
Open-source MCP server bridge for Inkra — drive a native macOS Markdown editor (live KaTeX/Mermaid preview) from Claude/Cursor.
Native macOS markdown preview + MCP server for Claude Code. Swift/SwiftUI, GFM, Mermaid, syntax highlighting. No Electron.
